status_vocabulary.closed_pass: Question answered positively for the declared scope; rerun only on an explicit trigger.
status_vocabulary.closed_negative: Question answered negatively; do not keep optimizing the same hypothesis without a material upstream change.
status_vocabulary.diagnostic_only: Evidence is valid for diagnosis/observability but cannot authorize production or a new estimator.
status_vocabulary.revalidate: A bounded rerun is required because an upstream governed contract changed; no redesign is implied.
status_vocabulary.superseded: Historical evidence retained for regression/provenance but no longer the active authority.

invariants.model_support_default_weight: unit rows unless the owning experiment explicitly declares otherwise
invariants.population_composition_weight: EPH PONDERA/PONDIH only when reproducing the relevant population estimand; Census target-year selected persons remain unit rows

surfaces.name: Telescope A — observed EPH poverty microscope
surfaces.question: Does the governed observed EPH measurement path reproduce auditable household/person poverty from raw welfare, composition, baskets and survey weights?
surfaces.outcome_authority: observed EPH ITF + governed CBA/CBT measurement
surfaces.entity_geography: EPH households/persons; native EPH region/agglomerate retained

current.note: A0 is canonical observed measurement; A1-A3 are diagnostic perturbations.

surfaces.promotion_role: Observed poverty truth/benchmark surface for Telescope B and commissioning; never a predictive estimator.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: EPH source, basket method/lines, adult-equivalence method, PONDIH semantics, or poverty measurement contract changes.

surfaces.name: Telescope B — same-household welfare bridge
surfaces.question: Holding the Telescope-A cohort, lines and weights fixed, where does observed→OOF point→predictive poverty divergence enter?
surfaces.outcome_authority: Telescope-A observed household state; OOF welfare and nested residual ECDF are model evidence
surfaces.entity_geography: same EPH households/persons as Telescope A

calibration.restriction: training-fold only; no global residual substitution

current.note: Additional quarters are optional replication, not a prerequisite for the Q3 scientific conclusion.

surfaces.promotion_role: Diagnoses point-model compression and predictive residual correction; feeds Telescope C.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: Welfare model, household folds, residual-calibration primitive, or Telescope-A cohort changes.

surfaces.name: Telescope C — EPH→Census welfare transport
surfaces.question: What changes when the frozen EPH welfare model/distribution leaves the EPH validation domain and scores the governed Census sample?
surfaces.outcome_authority: EPH validation only; Census has no observed welfare outcome authority
surfaces.entity_geography: EPH validation cohort versus governed Census target-year sample

calibration.restriction: no Census outcome calibration; no transport raking

current.note: Transport decomposition is valid evidence but does not by itself authorize production transport.

surfaces.rerun_trigger: Telescope-B model/distribution, semantic plane, Census donor/sample, or geography frame changes.

surfaces.name: L1 — EPH labor truth and official benchmark reproduction
surfaces.question: Can EPH weighted activity/employment/unemployment stocks and rates reproduce pinned official quarter benchmarks and accounting identities?
surfaces.outcome_authority: EPH ESTADO with PONDERA; pinned INDEC headline benchmarks are external validation only
surfaces.entity_geography: EPH persons; national plus 32 native agglomerates

current.note: Maximum official benchmark deviation previously commissioned below the 0.10 pp gate.

surfaces.promotion_role: Truth/target authority for labor commissioning and L3 calibration targets.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: EPH source release, ESTADO semantics, PONDERA semantics, or official benchmark snapshot changes.

surfaces.name: L2 — transportable labor reconstruction
surfaces.question: Can shared pre-labor EPH/Census covariates reconstruct coherent active / unemployed|active probabilities under household-grouped OOF evaluation?
surfaces.outcome_authority: EPH observed labor state for OOF evaluation only
surfaces.entity_geography: EPH persons for fit/evaluation; Census persons only for final inference

weights.model_fit: compare unit rows versus PONDERA; selection must be empirical

current.note: Corrected HGB/no-fit-weight grouped-5-fold OOF run excludes H06 and remains coherent (active Brier 0.104515; conditional-unemployment Brier 0.055632; simplex error 1.11e-16).

surfaces.promotion_role: Produces candidate labor probabilities only; L2 success does not authorize welfare use.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: Governed shared-feature contract, semantic roles, model family, fit-weight policy, or EPH period changes.

surfaces.name: L3 — Census labor marginal calibration
surfaces.question: Can raw Census labor probabilities be calibrated to governed agglomerate activity and unemployment targets while preserving a coherent probability simplex?
surfaces.outcome_authority: L1 PONDERA-weighted EPH targets inside EPH frame
surfaces.entity_geography: 32 EPH agglomerates; outside-frame rows remain explicitly unbenchmarked

calibration.qa: employment rate + simplex consistency; no third independent hard constraint

current.note: Consumes the exact corrected L2 artifact. 32 calibrated EPH-frame domains plus one outside-frame unbenchmarked domain; maximum target residual 9.47e-11 pp; simplex error 1.11e-16.

surfaces.promotion_role: Creates a calibrated labor-analysis layer; does not authorize labor probabilities as welfare features.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: L2 model release, L1 target release, calibration domains, or calibration algorithm changes.

surfaces.name: L4 — labor→welfare shadow adjudication
surfaces.question: Do transportable labor probabilities recover enough of the true-labor welfare oracle gain to justify inclusion in the income model?
surfaces.outcome_authority: EPH observed income/poverty for OOF welfare evaluation; Census remains transport-only
surfaces.entity_geography: exact source-backed EPH person identity; Census only after governed L3

weights.transport: none beyond explicit L3 labor calibration

calibration.comparison: no-labor vs true-labor oracle vs OOF labor-probability bridge

current.note: True-labor oracle improves person and household welfare metrics, while the transportable labor bridge is neutral/slightly harmful. Labor is welfare-relevant, but the commissioned transportable reconstruction is not a useful welfare feature; stop unless an explicit upstream rerun trigger fires.

surfaces.promotion_role: Only labor surface capable of authorizing bridge features into welfare production.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: L2 governed feature contract/model, exact identity surface, or welfare model/folds change.

surfaces.name: Thin EPH↔Census within-agglomerate domain diagnostic
surfaces.question: How separable are EPH and Census within the governed EPH frame under stable/shared, target-period-state, and research-only feature tiers?
surfaces.outcome_authority: source identity only; no welfare or labor outcome
surfaces.entity_geography: EPH_TOTAL + 32 native agglomerates; outside-frame Census preserved separately

weights.measurement: two lenses: unit model-support; EPH PONDERA population composition

current.note: Corrected canonicalization/missingness refresh preserved the source-separation interpretation: EPH_TOTAL OOF AUC S=0.514802, S+T=0.706180, S+T+R=0.811938. Diagnostic only; no transport weights or production authorization.

surfaces.promotion_role: Transport warning and block-attribution evidence only; never generates transport weights.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: Semantic plane, donor vintage, EPH geography relation, exact model-support universe, or domain-diagnostic implementation changes.

surfaces.name: M1 — income/basket timing sensitivity
surfaces.question: Holding the Telescope-A A0 cohort, ITF, PONDIH and adult equivalence fixed, how much do quarter-native current, one-month-lagged and midpoint basket clocks move observed EPH poverty?
surfaces.outcome_authority: Telescope-A observed EPH A0; monthly governed official basket values are threshold evidence only
surfaces.entity_geography: same observed EPH households/persons as Telescope A; national plus six basket regions

calibration.restriction: threshold clock only; no household-specific receipt month is asserted

current.note: T0 must reproduce Telescope A exactly. T1 shifts each monthly CBA/CBT one month backward; Tm is the current/lag midpoint. M2 reporting drift and non-response calibration are out of scope.

surfaces.promotion_role: Observed-EPH timing sensitivity only; cannot alter canonical Telescope A or production thresholds.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: Monthly basket parent, Telescope-A A0 household state, adult equivalence, or timing-policy contract changes.

surfaces.name: M3 — signed-sales ENGHo/Engel threshold sensitivity
surfaces.question: Holding Telescope-A observed welfare, weights and adult equivalence fixed, how do signed-sales ENGHo17 level-only and level-plus-trajectory CBT paths change observed EPH poverty?
surfaces.outcome_authority: Telescope-A observed EPH A0 plus candidate/diagnostic research.argentina-regional-baskets-engel-sensitivity/v1 threshold paths
surfaces.entity_geography: same observed EPH households/persons as Telescope A; national plus six basket regions

calibration.restriction: official CBA fixed; only CBT/ICE changes through signed-sales Artifact B

current.scope: implemented for 2022-Q1..2025-Q4; real 16-quarter Poverty-side materialization pending
current.note: Requires Artifact B locked to research.argentina-engel-reference-structure/engho-2017-18-p29-p48-signed-sales-v2. External CEDLAS values are validation only.

surfaces.promotion_role: Observed-EPH ENGHo/Engel ablation only; does not promote alternative thresholds to production.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: Signed-sales Artifact A/B, regional IPC parent, official basket parent, or Telescope-A A0 state changes.

surfaces.name: Commissioning dashboard
surfaces.question: Can already-governed evidence be summarized consistently against pinned benchmarks and across periods without creating new estimands?

current.note: Dashboard/registry are observability surfaces and must never become estimator parents.

surfaces.promotion_role: Presentation, status, benchmark and audit synthesis only.
surfaces.rerun_trigger: Referenced governed artifacts or benchmark snapshots change.
